dudu_click.tooltip: Click event: start/stop the timer on the timer page

dudu_connect_wifi.message0: Dudu clock connect WiFi timeout %1 s
dudu_connect_wifi.tooltip: Connect the saved WiFi; on timeout clear the config and reboot into provisioning

dudu_double_click.tooltip: Double-click event: cycle pages weather → air → forecast → theme → timer → reset

dudu_has_config.message0: Dudu clock has saved WiFi config?
dudu_has_config.tooltip: Returns true when SSID, password and city are stored in NVS

dudu_init.tooltip: Initialize the ST7789 display in portrait 240x320 and load the saved theme and WiFi/city configuration

dudu_long_press.message0: Dudu clock button long press (theme/reset counter/factory reset)
dudu_long_press.tooltip: Long-press event: toggle theme on the theme page, zero the counter on the timer page, factory reset on the reset page

dudu_run.message0: Dudu clock run one frame (call in loop)
dudu_run.tooltip: Main-loop body: refresh time/timer per page, run background tasks and portal listener; must be called repeatedly in the loop

dudu_set_api_host.tooltip: Set the dedicated QWeather API host (accounts after 2024 look like xxx.re.qweatherapi.com, see console); empty falls back to the public domains; call before init

dudu_set_weather_key.message0: Dudu clock set QWeather API key %1
dudu_set_weather_key.tooltip: Set the QWeather API key (free registration at qweather.com); must be called before init

dudu_start_config_portal.tooltip: Start the DuduClock SoftAP hotspot and show a QR code; connect with a phone and open 192.168.1.1 to configure WiFi and city

dudu_start_tasks.tooltip: Start periodic tasks: astronaut animation, message rotation, weather every 60 min, network check every 5 min, NTP every 58 min

dudu_sync_data.message0: Dudu clock sync initial data (NTP + weather + air)
dudu_sync_data.tooltip: Sync NTP time and query current weather, air quality and the 7-day forecast; retries on failure and reboots after 60 s
